deadline.intake: Fall 2027 intake, regular admission (early admission 15 Jan 2027; rolling 1 Jun 2027 where capacity allows)

tuition.note: International students, all programmes except Business/Economics (BA Business and BS Economics: 4,750,000 AMD); Fall 2026 cycle, before financial aid; plus 25,000 AMD student services fee

requirement.text: Applicants must submit proof of high school graduation (or equivalent such as IB, A-levels, GED), and demonstrate English and math proficiency through accepted tests such as the SAT or the AUA entrance exams; English test scores must be under two years old.
